verdict.rationale: Jan explicitly supports creating custom assistants with persona/instruction configuration (e.g. 'Act as a software engineering mentor...') and lets users assign a specific assistant/persona per project so conversations automatically use chosen instructions. This is documented first-party across GitHub feature lists and docs.ai pages. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports validating the assistant customization workflow beyond vendor docs, and more detail on assistant configuration breadth (e.g. tool access scoping per assistant).
